summary: Master inventory management with our comprehensive training course. Gain essential skills to streamline stock control and boost your operational effectiveness.
lede: Stock management training helps supply chain planners, warehouse managers and stock analysts balance product availability with inventory costs. It covers checking stock accuracy, classifying items with ABC/XYZ analysis, and planning cycle counts to manage physical inventory. Learners also explore demand forecasting, safety-stock and reorder-point calculations, and replenishment models such as Economic Order Quantity.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals responsible for inventory accuracy, warehouse management, and working capital optimization across manufacturing, retail, distribution, and public sector supply chains. This course is designed for: Inventory Control Manager overseeing multi-site warehouse stock levels and accuracy benchmarks. Supply Chain Analyst optimizing safety stock parameters and replenishment reorder points. Warehouse Operations Supervisor managing physical stock movements and cycle counting routines. Materials Management Specialist coordinating raw material availability for production schedules. Procurement Lead balancing bulk order volume discounts against carrying cost constraints. Logistics Operations Manager integrating inventory velocity with transportation and fulfillment networks. Financial Controller monitoring inventory holding costs, valuation, and write-off risks. Demand Planner translating sales forecasts into operational inventory replenishment targets. Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Super-User configuring automated stock control replenishment parameters. Stores and Inventory Auditor verifying physical stock balances against digital inventory records.
modules: Inventory Fundamentals and Financial Value Optimization
Demand Forecasting and Material Requirements Integration
Inventory Replenishment Models and Lot Sizing Strategies
Dynamic Safety Stock and Reorder Point Optimization
Physical Inventory Control and Precision Cycle Counting
Storage Location Optimization and Warehouse Velocity Control
Strategic Inventory Governance, KPIs, and Technology Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of two years of operational experience in inventory control, warehouse operations, logistics, or purchasing. Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel (formulas, functions, and data sorting) is required to complete the practical quantitative workshops. No programming or software coding experience is necessary.
